purpose: Downgrade advisory investigation attention after an isolated target-specific failure has been followed by enough clean scheduled probes, while preserving the raw degraded health window and every fail-closed gate.
qualification: Only target items already classified as target_specific and target_investigation are eligible.
Recovery evidence is calculated from the same target and health-attention window.
The latest result per scheduled minute is used so retries do not inflate evidence.
The last failed result in the window is the recovery anchor.
At least the configured number of later scheduled samples must exist.
Every later scheduled sample must pass its contract and the latest result must be a pass.
A newer failure immediately prevents recovery classification.
invariants: Raw health state, probe results and estate state are never rewritten or suppressed.
Release admission and rollback state are never overridden.
The overlay does not retry probes, restart apps, redeploy services or mutate provider configuration.
Target-specific raw counts remain visible; separate recovered/actionable counts are added.
Mixed or unresolved health failures are never auto-reclassified as recovered.
Browser roles receive no EXECUTE grant.
